faqs.question: What is Split Pay?
faqs.answer:
Split Pay lets you split your biggest monthly bills into two parts — one on your due date, one two weeks later — without ever being late.

We work with rent, mortgage, and car payments today. Your landlord, lender, or servicer gets the full payment on the day it's due. You just have a little breathing room between paychecks.

No interest, no loans. Just a payment service that solves a timing problem.

Prefer to watch? Here's a quick video on how it works: Watch how Split Pay works.

Apply free in a couple of minutes — you'll see your exact split amounts right after approval.

faqs.question: Can I split multiple bills at the same time?
faqs.answer:
Right now, one Split Pay at a time per person.

That means you can choose to use Split Pay on your rent or your mortgage or your car payment — but not multiple at the same time.

You can switch, though. Once your current Split Pay is fully paid off, you can apply for a different bill type anytime. Paying on time builds your eligibility, and you can always switch back later when life changes.

Apply free in a couple of minutes — start with the bill that needs the most flexibility.

faqs.question: Is this a loan?
faqs.answer:
No. Split Pay is a payment service, not a lender.

There's no interest, no credit check that affects your score, and no debt building up. You authorize us to pay your bill on your due date — and you pay us back in two parts.

Apply free in a couple of minutes.

faqs.question: How do I sign up for Split Pay?
faqs.answer:
Two minutes. Open the Split Pay app or head to splitpay.com, tap Apply, and we'll walk you through it.

We'll review your financial profile and give you an instant decision. If approved, you'll see your exact Split Pay amount and can start using it right away.

Applying is free and doesn't affect your credit score.

Apply free in a couple of minutes.

faqs.question: How does Split Pay connect to my bills?
faqs.answer:
Once you're approved, you'll get unique Split Pay account and routing numbers that work with the bill you're splitting.

For mortgage, car payment, or rent paid through a portal: add the numbers to your servicer or portal as a payment method.

For rent paid directly to your landlord: Split Pay sends rent to them — they get a one-click notification to accept.

You only need to connect once.

Here's a video that walks through adding your account and routing numbers. Quick heads up: it's filmed for renters, but the steps are identical if you're paying a mortgage or car payment. Just ignore the rent-specific bits and follow along. (Mortgage and auto versions are on the way.)

https://youtube.com/shorts/CiZKl3pR9J4

Apply free in a couple of minutes to get your account numbers.

faqs.question: When is the second part of my payment due?
faqs.answer:
Your second Split Pay payment is due 14 days after your first payment.

You'll see the exact date in the Split Pay app and confirmation email. It pulls automatically from the debit card on file, and you can pay early anytime.

We'll send text and email reminders before and around your due date. Each one has a quick link to pay or change the date if you need to.

Apply free in a couple of minutes to see exactly when your payments would land.

faqs.question: Do landlords or lenders need to sign up?
faqs.answer:
In most cases, no.

For mortgage and car payments: your servicer doesn't need to do anything. You just add Split Pay's account and routing numbers to their payment system.

For rent paid through a property portal: your landlord doesn't need to know. The full rent arrives on time through your portal like always.

For rent paid directly to your landlord: they need to accept the payment, create an account, and add their bank to receive it. Takes them about two minutes — but that's all they have to do.

Apply free in a couple of minutes to see what your setup looks like.

faqs.question: Are there fees to use Split Pay?
faqs.answer:
Split Pay charges two simple fees per bill you split:

  • $9.99 flat Split Pay fee

  • 1.5% of your total payment

Examples: $1,500 rent → $32.49 · $2,400 mortgage → $45.99 · $450 car payment → $16.74

You'll see the exact fee on the approval screen before you commit.

No late fees on your second payment. No setup fees. No interest. Applying is free and doesn't affect your credit.

Apply free in a couple of minutes to see your exact fees.

faqs.question: Does Split Pay build credit?
faqs.answer:
Yes — and the rules are designed so it can only help.

Split Pay reports your successful rent payments to two of the major credit bureaus. Reporting is opt-in and free, and only on-time payments count — late or missed payments are never reported.

Especially useful for renters: rent is usually one of your biggest monthly expenses, but most landlords don't report it. With Split Pay, every on-time rent payment can build your credit. (Car payments and mortgages are already on your credit report through your lender.)

Applying for Split Pay doesn't affect your credit score.

Apply free in a couple of minutes to build credit with rent you're already paying.

faqs.question: Is my bank info safe?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Split Pay uses bank-grade encryption, we never store your bank login credentials, and our banking partner is FDIC-insured.

Your Split Pay account and routing numbers are unique to you — you can use them across bills without exposing your personal bank account.

Apply free in a couple of minutes with confidence.

faqs.question: How do you decide who's approved?
faqs.answer:
Eligibility is based on your individual financial profile — things like deposit patterns, account balances, and payment history. No credit score requirement. No income threshold.

The fastest way to find out if you qualify and for how much: apply. It's free, takes about two minutes, and doesn't affect your credit score.

Apply free in a couple of minutes.

faqs.question: Does using Split Pay require a credit check?
faqs.answer:
No. Split Pay never runs a credit check. Not when you apply, and not while you use it.

There's no credit pull of any kind and no credit score requirement. Approval is based on your financial profile: things like deposit patterns, account balances, and payment history. Applying is free, takes about two minutes, and has zero effect on your credit score.

The only time Split Pay touches your credit is if you ask it to. You can opt in to free credit reporting, and only your on-time payments are ever reported.

Apply free in a couple of minutes.
